field_map.name: interact_angle_a_deg
field_map.meaning: angle limit A (-1 = none; 360 l3-inspect/contextual-look, 180 horse)

field_map.name: flag_01c_traversal
field_map.meaning: set only on climb-up/down, rope-climb, horse

field_map.name: approach_angle_b_deg
field_map.meaning: object-relative approach cone (-1 none; drawer 110, workbench 72.5, lockpick 80)

field_map.name: flag_049_no_los_probe
field_map.meaning: set on controller-shake, dropped pickups, l3-inspect, contextual-look; cleared by *-los variants

field_map.name: anchor_joint
field_map.meaning: joint used as interaction/icon anchor (handle, neck, lock, root...)

field_map.name: offset_x
field_map.meaning: interaction point offset from object locator (x)

field_map.name: flag_0ba_not_pickup
field_map.meaning: 205 defs; clear on every pickup/collectible def (pickup-scan default?)

field_map.name: button_icon
field_map.meaning: button glyph id (gen:interact etc.), rendered as '%s@large'

field_map.name: flag_0ec_shows_unavailable
field_map.meaning: doors, ammo pickups, dead-drops, needs-key (can show greyed/unavailable prompt?)

field_map.name: joypad_command
field_map.meaning: joypad command polled (0 => native default, object-interact)

field_map.name: sound_inventory_full
field_map.meaning: sfx played when pickup refused (inventory full)

field_map.name: flag_148_los_probe
field_map.meaning: 1 except plain ammo pickups (the -los variant sets it)

field_map.name: prompt_style
field_map.meaning: prompt layout: interact | double-dynamic | simple | double

field_map.name: allow_on_horse
field_map.meaning: byte +427 read by accessibility-pathfind: 0 => systemic dismount needed

field_map.name: special_item
field_map.meaning: byte +506 read by blind-listen-mode: special vs pickup sonar sound

field_map.name: mash_hold_hybrid
field_map.meaning: byte +507 read by draw-interactable-hud: show hold widget if mashes-are-holds

notes: Def assignment to a world object comes from the object's level-data tag `interactable-def` (read in DC via tag-symbol(interactable-def, obj)); scripts swap it with override-interact-def.

raw = every word of the 0x200 struct keyed by offset: 'ptr:<string>' (8-byte relocated pointer), 'sid:<name>' (8-byte resolved SID), else 'u32/i32/f32' views of the 4-byte word. Flag words are byte-packed bools; see field_map u8 entries.
